To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the graphical lasso is inconsistent in a class of sparse bipartite graphs, and that this class of sparse bippartite graphs arises often in gene expression networks, and therefore the graphical lasso should be used with caution in this application.
ℓ1-based sparse precision matrix estimation methods fail to learn the structure of many sparse bipartites graphs that are commonly used for gene regulation networks.
the graphical lasso fails to recover the correct structure for a class of models with nearly linear dependency between variables and this class of models is very common in practice.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following questions: (a) what is the consistency of sparse precision matrix estimation methods for sparse bipartite graphs, (b) how do the results compare with the results for general sparse graphs, and (c) what are the practical implications of the results for real data analysis?
